notes.title: Playtest Version 1.1.1.36 Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Dear Diary,[/p][p]The Station Master just called me in to explain why I haven't submitted a work report for two months.[/p][p]I was shocked because I had no idea that patching every single hole on the space station required formal documentation. This is killing me! It's like trying to remember what you had for lunch every single day for the past two months... Well, that's a bad example because lunch is the same every day, but you get my point.[/p][p]I'm absolutely certain I've done over 30 version updates for this test build, fixing more than 200 critical bugs, but none of it got recorded.[/p][p]Hopefully, starting today, I won't make the same kind of mistake again.[/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Playtest Version 1.1.1.36 Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1][olist][*][p]Fixed the issue where the Ranger starship's vanguard effect was not applying correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the "Indiscriminate Inertial System" effect was incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with the Cook's supply rotation being incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the Diner's special module reward could unlock Recycling Section collection progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various UI display errors.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]That's all for now, work again tomorrow. [/p][p]I hope I can wrap up this project before next spring and return to Earth.[/p][p]Even though there's no one waiting for me there.[/p][p]Good night, dear diary.[/p]
